map.由样本均值、假设均值与标准差求 t 值 使用指南: t-Value from Sample Mean, Hypothesized Mean, and Standard Deviation User Guide
map.输入样本均值 x̄、假设均值 μ、标准差 s 与样本量 n，求 t 统计量。: Enter the sample mean x̄, hypothesized mean μ, standard deviation s, and sample size n to get the t statistic.
map.t=(x̄−μ)/(s/√n)，单样本标准化。: t = (x̄−μ)/(s/√n), standardized for a one-sample test.
map.小样本均值检验核心量。: The core quantity for small-sample mean tests.
map.df=n−1 查 t 分布。: Look up the t distribution with df = n − 1.
map.：x̄=120：t=20/3≈6.67，远超临界，显著。: : x̄ = 120: t = 20/3 ≈ 6.67, far beyond the critical value — significant.
map.由数值序列求样本方差: Compute the Sample Variance from a Series
map.由试验数、成功概率与上限求累积概率: Compute the Cumulative Probability from Trial Count, Success Probability, and Limit
map.形式相同，但 t 用样本 s 且服从 t 分布（胖尾），z 用已知 σ 服正态。: The form is the same, but t uses the sample s and follows the t distribution (fat tails), while z uses a known σ and follows the normal.
map.df 决定 t 分布形状，df 小尾巴厚、临界值大，更保守。: df determines the shape of the t distribution: small df means fat tails and larger critical values, which is more conservative.
